record.context_brief: Polynomial formulae relating A_q^{diag} and augmented q-Onsager
record.original_question: For the current algebra A_q^{diag} arising from a quotient of the reflection equation algebra, and the augmented q-Onsager algebra generated by K_0, K_1, Z_1, and Z̃_1 with the displayed defining relations, determine explicit polynomial formulae expressing the generators or current modes of A_q^{diag} in terms of the augmented q-Onsager algebra, so that the precise algebraic relationship between A_q^{diag} and the augmented q-Onsager algebra is made explicit.

evidence.quote: Problem 1-b: Show that the infinite dimensional algebra Adiag q , the augmented q−OA and the above coideal subalgebra of Uq(slc2) are isomorphic; Find the polynomial formulae which relates Adiag q to the augmented q−OA.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{F} = \mathbb{C}(q)$ with $q$ an indeterminate. Consider the following two associative $\mathbb{F}$-algebras.

(1) The current algebra $A_q^{\mathrm{diag}}$ obtained as the quotient of the reflection equation algebra associated with the diagonal $K$-matrix for $U_q(\widehat{sl}_2)$. It is generated by infinite families of "current modes" $\{\mathcal{W}_{-k},\mathcal{W}_{k+1},\mathcal{G}_{k+1},\tilde{\mathcal{G}}_{k+1}\}_{k\ge 0}$ subject to the standard defining relations of the Baseilhac–Koizumi/Baseilhac–Shigechi current algebra (the alternating central extension of the $q$-Onsager algebra).

(2) The augmented $q$-Onsager algebra, the unital associative $\mathbb{F}$-algebra generated by $K_0$, $K_1$, $Z_1$, $\tilde Z_1$ subject to the relations
$$K_0K_1 = K_1K_0,\qquad K_iK_i^{-1}=K_i^{-1}K_i=1,$$
$$K_0 Z_1 = q^{-2} Z_1 K_0,\quad K_1 Z_1 = q^{2} Z_1 K_1,\quad K_0 \tilde Z_1 = q^{2}\tilde Z_1 K_0,\quad K_1 \tilde Z_1 = q^{-2}\tilde Z_1 K_1,$$
together with the $q$-Serre–type relations
$$Z_1^3 \tilde Z_1 - [3]_q Z_1^2 \tilde Z_1 Z_1 + [3]_q Z_1 \tilde Z_1 Z_1^2 - \tilde Z_1 Z_1^3 = 0,$$
$$\tilde Z_1^3 Z_1 - [3]_q \tilde Z_1^2 Z_1 \tilde Z_1 + [3]_q \tilde Z_1 Z_1 \tilde Z_1^2 - Z_1\tilde Z_1^3 = 0,$$
where $[3]_q = q^2+1+q^{-2}$.

Find explicit polynomial formulae expressing the generators (equivalently, all current modes $\mathcal{W}_{-k},\mathcal{W}_{k+1},\mathcal{G}_{k+1},\tilde{\mathcal{G}}_{k+1}$) of $A_q^{\mathrm{diag}}$ as noncommutative polynomials in $K_0^{\pm 1}, K_1^{\pm 1}, Z_1, \tilde Z_1$, thereby making explicit the precise algebraic relationship (in particular, an isomorphism or embedding) between $A_q^{\mathrm{diag}}$ and the augmented $q$-Onsager algebra.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work (Terwilliger 2021 and follow-ups) established that the alternating central extension of the $q$-Onsager algebra is isomorphic to $O_q \otimes \mathbb{F}[z_1,z_2,\dots]$, and that its generators admit polynomial expressions in the $q$-Onsager generators plus central elements. The augmented $q$-Onsager algebra (Ito–Terwilliger) appears in related works on diagonal $K$-operators. However, an explicit, completely worked-out polynomial dictionary identifying the current modes of $A_q^{\mathrm{diag}}$ with elements of the augmented $q$-Onsager algebra in the specific form requested does not appear to be unambiguously available in the literature found, so the status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: The Alternating Central Extension of the q-Onsager Algebra
status_evidence.snippet: The alternating central extension has a presentation involving the alternating generators and a large number of relations; it is isomorphic to O_q tensor a polynomial algebra.
status_evidence.claim: Polynomial-type structural results for the alternating central extension of the q-Onsager algebra exist.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic representations of augmented q-Onsager algebra and boundary K-operators
status_evidence.snippet: Intertwining relations of the augmented q-Onsager algebra introduced by Ito and Terwilliger yield diagonal boundary K-operators solving the reflection equation.
status_evidence.claim: The augmented q-Onsager algebra is connected to diagonal K-operators for the reflection equation.

status_evidence.title: On diagonal solutions of the reflection equation
status_evidence.snippet: Studies diagonal solutions of the reflection equation in connection with q-Onsager-type algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Related but distinct framework; does not give the explicit polynomial dictionary requested.
